title: Offer Your Space. Share the SloWork Manifesto.
subtitle: We connect hosts with people seeking coworking, coliving, and purposeful remote work environments. Your space becomes a haven for deep work, mental wellness, and group activities in touch with nature.
body: As a SloWork Host, you embrace and promote our Manifesto: conscious rhythms, healthy boundaries, respectful community, and commitment to sustainability. Resources, support, and a network of hosts who share the same ethics.
videoTitle: The SloWork Manifesto: ethics and guidelines
